name: place_objects
description: Add objects to the world (can be called many times). Optionally set environment and spawn too. Stack with on_top_of (index within this call) or on_top_of_id (id from an earlier call). Returns the new ids and any problems (dropped objects, overlaps).

x.description: Footprint center, meters from the west edge (0..10)

z.description: Footprint center, meters from the north edge (0..10)

rotation.description: Degrees around the vertical axis. 0 = front faces south (+z), 90 = east (+x), 180 = north, 270 = west

face_x.description: With face_z: turn the front toward this point instead of giving rotation

y.description: Height of the object bottom above ground in meters (default 0)

on_top_of.description: Stand on an EARLIER object in this same call: its 0-based index in this objects list

on_top_of_id.description: Stand on an object placed in an earlier call: its id (e.g. "12")

ground.description: Ground texture id from the offered ground list (plain colors grass/meadow/sand/snow/stone/dirt/lava also work)

sky.description: Sky id from the offered sky list; it also sets the ambient light (plain day/sunset/night/overcast also work)

shading.description: Lighting mood: bright = midday sun, soft = diffuse, golden = warm low sun, moody = dim and contrasty, night = dark with cool light

name: move_object
description: Move and/or rotate an existing object by id. Objects stacked on it do not move with it.

name: capture_view
description: Look at the current world: returns images (top-down map with a 1 m grid and object ids, an overview, and eye-level views from open spots) plus a text list of every object with its footprint. Use it after each phase and fix what looks wrong.

views.description: Default: top, overview and 2 eye-level views

name: finish
description: Call when the world is complete.
